notes: Initial story breakdown for Provider Search backend

change_log.value: Core provider search logic with vector + taxonomy fallback
Provider search unit and integration tests

FEAT-1-STORY-001.title: Define provider search request/response schema
FEAT-1-STORY-001.description: Implement and validate Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, location, specialty) and structured response payload including providers, distance, and taxonomy metadata.

FEAT-1-STORY-002.title: Implement provider search core logic
FEAT-1-STORY-002.description: Build provider search service using MongoDB Atlas vector search with fallback to taxonomy (NUCC codes), including location filtering via FIPS/county mapping and multi-stage query handling.

FEAT-1-STORY-003.title: Integrate provider search into FindCare facade
FEAT-1-STORY-003.description: Expose provider search through find_care_facade, wiring specialty identification and provider search service into a unified orchestration callable by the tool router.

FEAT-1-STORY-004.title: Provider search tests (unit + integration)
FEAT-1-STORY-004.description: Create unit tests for provider_search_service and integration tests validating end-to-end flow through facade and tool router with realistic queries and location filters.
FEAT-1-STORY-004.evidence: GAP: No existing provider search test file found; must be created under backend/tests/
